title: MSC #14 - Settlement Summary (October 2026)
headline: The October 2026 settlement summary for Spark, Grove and Keel, published by Soter Labs for the Amatsu executor agent, includes Reconciliation IV once and says no payment has been executed.
summary: Soter Labs, on behalf of the Amatsu Operational Executor Agent, publishes initial calculations under the Monthly Settlement Cycle for Spark, Grove and Keel. Demand-side primitives are incentives to prime agents plus treasury income; supply-side primitives are returns on allocated capital after borrowing costs and the Sky Direct Exposure treatment. October revenue is shown separately from adjustments. For Spark, the demand-side total is 900,219.94 USDS; the supply-side total splits into a Spark share of 3,038,737.81 USDS and a Sky share of 10,224,716.81 USDS. Adjustments from Reconciliation IV are included once: a prime supply-side correction of +249,141.52 USDS and a Sky supply-side correction of +536,094.04 USDS. The instructions include minting 14,048,690 USDS of debt in ALLOCATOR-SPARK-A and sending 4,188,099 USDS from the surplus buffer to the Spark subproxy. The post says calculations are pinned to a merged commit, final amounts are rounded to whole USDS, and later reconciliations can correct discrepancies. Grove and Keel figures were not reviewed in the excerpt.
risk_flags: large USDS mint and transfer instructions
